title: rete plaza
tagline: a gathering place for self-describing semantic datasets
_about: Each dataset's facts (counts, predicates, classes, vocabularies, signals, starter queries, license) are read at runtime straight from the .rete file's embedded Dataset Card — this manifest only adds what the card can't carry: visual identity (icon/tags), companion table downloads (Parquet/DuckDB/SQLite), and outbound links. Companion URLs marked "verified": false follow the bucket naming convention and should be confirmed before publishing.

datasets.title: scholar — synthetic scholarly world
datasets.blurb: 250 papers, 137 authors, 36 venues with power-law citations, field communities and typed literals — a clean playground for SPARQL.

datasets.title: causal — cardiometabolic causal model
datasets.blurb: ~30 typed factors wired by a transitive :causes relation, with planted defects so the coherence reasoner has something to find (it does — watch the fingerprint).

datasets.title: history — world borders, 323 BCE → 1994 CE
datasets.blurb: Territorial borders at 7 snapshots as GeoSPARQL wktLiterals with integer years — point-in-polygon + temporal filters in the browser.

datasets.title: nomisma — coinage of Alexander the Great (PELLA)
datasets.blurb: 7,228 ancient Greek coin types struck 359–65 BC, each linked to mint, authority, material, denomination and region — fully self-describing with English labels.

ontologies.name: Nomisma Ontology
ontologies.desc: Nomisma.org ontology for numismatic concepts (mints, denominations, materials, regions).

datasets.title: linked-jazz — jazz musician social network
datasets.blurb: 54 interviewed musicians fan out to ~1,940 people they mention, with who-knows-whom ties — genuine multi-hop paths (transitive knowsOf / mentorOf).

datasets.title: getty-ulan — artist mentorship lineage (remote, lazy)
datasets.blurb: ~28,300 artists connected by 'who taught whom' (gvp:teacherOf). Rembrandt has ~369 artistic descendants via teacherOf+. Queried lazily over HTTP range.

datasets.title: wikidata-100MB — a real 100 MB Wikidata slice (remote, lazy)
datasets.blurb: ~104 MB of Wikidata people & places, queried lazily — a typical selective query faults in ~10 MB, never the whole file. Companion entity tables sit beside it in the bucket.

datasets.title: ohm-full — all of OpenHistoricalMap (remote, lazy)
datasets.blurb: The entire OpenHistoricalMap planet — 1,021,295 named, dated, geolocated features (~6.1M triples, 150 MB) — as one range-queried .rete.

datasets.title: chemotion — chemistry ELN knowledge graph (remote, lazy)
datasets.blurb: The Chemotion ELN graph (FIZ Karlsruhe) merged with CHMO + RXNO — 1.53M triples, built with `rete build --card`, so its card is rich and read live here. Federates with chebi-full.

datasets.title: chebi-full — the complete ChEBI ontology (remote, lazy)
datasets.blurb: The entire ChEBI ontology — 8.83M triples, 120 MB — range-queried in the browser. Built with `rete build --card`; lossless Parquet/DuckDB/SQLite table companions sit beside it.
